title: sokf locate report
description: The report of `sokf locate --json`: one entry for each id, in argument order (CLI-8_AC-5).

Location.description: A location entry holds one id and where its document is.

path.description: The absolute filesystem path of the document.

asset.description: The absolute filesystem path of the asset, when the document is a sidecar: a document that describes a separate file, the asset.
